title: OURO
shortDescription: An integrated communications direction for ORIVS and its OURO personal-audio product.

overview.heading: One product. One connected story.
overview.intro: An integrated communications direction for ORIVS and its OURO personal-audio product.
overview.heroNote: An integrated communications direction for ORIVS and its OURO personal-audio product.
overview.editorialIntro: An integrated communications direction for ORIVS and its OURO personal-audio product.
overview.body:
Introducing a product takes more than a **strong identity** or a well-executed launch. It calls for a **clear understanding** of what the product represents, how it should be positioned, and how its story should travel across audiences and channels. For ORIVS, the introduction of OURO presented an opportunity to bring these considerations together as **one communications challenge**.

The work extended beyond visual identity to consider positioning, creative direction, the launch experience and the communication of the product’s wider business potential. Rather than treating each element as a separate exercise, Detailed developed a **connected direction** intended to give the product a **consistent narrative and visual foundation** across formats, platforms and stages of its introduction.

brandIdentity.heading: A recognizable identity, built around the product.
brandIdentity.intro: Building a recognizable visual identity for OURO.
brandIdentity.heroIntro: Building a recognizable visual identity for OURO.
brandIdentity.editorialHeading: A surreal identity, built around the product.
brandIdentity.editorialIntro: A visual language designed to give OURO a consistent presence across its communications.
brandIdentity.body:
**OURO’s** brand identity forms part of the wider product introduction, giving the product a **recognizable visual presence** across its communications. The identity direction connects the product’s visual expression with the **positioning and narrative** developed for its launch.

Across different applications, the aim is to maintain a **clear sense of consistency** while allowing the system to adapt to different formats and contexts. The work shown here brings together selected identity applications to demonstrate how the **visual language** is expressed across the product’s wider communications.

launch.heading: Bringing the product story to its launch moment.
launch.intro: Bringing the product story to its launch moment and communicating the wider business opportunity.
launch.heroIntro: Bringing the product story to its launch moment and communicating the wider business opportunity.
launch.editorialHeading: Bringing the product story to its launch moment.
launch.editorialIntro: Connecting the launch concept, keynote narrative and campaign communications through one coordinated direction.
launch.body:
The launch communications work explored how OURO’s identity and strategic narrative could be brought together in a **coordinated product introduction**. At its centre was the **NEXT ’26 launch concept**, providing a framework for connecting the event identity, keynote storytelling, campaign communications and the wider launch experience.

The direction considered the **launch as a journey** from building awareness and anticipation to the main product presentation and the communications supporting it. The aim was to make each element feel part of the same introduction, with a **consistent story** carried across the different moments and materials.

eventBrandIdentity.heading: One visual language, expressed across the launch.
eventBrandIdentity.heroHeading: One visual language, expressed across the launch.
eventBrandIdentity.intro: Extending the OURO story into the event environment.
eventBrandIdentity.heroNote: The event identity carries the OURO product story into the room, from the stage to the materials people hold.
eventBrandIdentity.editorialHeading: One visual language, expressed across the launch.
eventBrandIdentity.editorialIntro: Extending the OURO story into the event environment.
eventBrandIdentity.body:
Within the **NEXT ’26 launch concept**, the event identity brought the OURO product story into the event environment. The visual direction was intended to carry a **consistent identity** across the different points where the launch was experienced, from the **main stage** to supporting materials and other event touchpoints.

Together, the applications show how **one design direction** can work across different surfaces, formats and moments while remaining connected to the **wider product narrative**.

keynoteSlides.title: OPENING FILM
keynoteSlides.speaker: None
keynoteSlides.script: **Purpose:** Introduce ORIVS and establish its philosophy before the launch begins.
keynoteSlides.scriptNote: **Transition note:** Film resolves into NEXT ’26. CEO walks on stage.

keynoteSlides.title: NEXT '26
keynoteSlides.speaker: CEO
keynoteSlides.script:
Good morning.

Thank you for joining us.

Every year we come together to share what we're building.

But today...

We'd like to begin somewhere else.

We'd like to begin with people.

keynoteSlides.title: THE FUTURE ISN'T LOUDER
keynoteSlides.speaker: CEO
keynoteSlides.script:
Technology has never been more capable.

Every year it's faster.

Smarter.

More connected.

Yet somewhere along the way...

It also became louder.

More notifications.

More interruptions.

More demands on our attention.

We believe the future should feel different.

keynoteSlides.title: DESIGNED AROUND LIFE
keynoteSlides.speaker: CEO
keynoteSlides.script:
*Motion opening text:* Life doesn't happen in one place...

Life doesn't happen in one place.

It moves.

Between work...

And home.

Between movement...

And stillness.

Between focus...

And rest.

We believed technology should move naturally through those moments.

Not ask us to reorganize our lives around it.

keynoteSlides.title: ONE QUESTION
keynoteSlides.speaker: CEO
keynoteSlides.script:
*Opening text:* So we asked ourselves one question...

So we asked ourselves one question.

Not...

keynoteSlides.title: HOW SHOULD PERSONAL AUDIO FEEL?
keynoteSlides.script:
*On-screen text:*

How can we add more?

But...

How should personal audio feel?

How should personal audio feel?
keynoteSlides.scriptNote: This content belongs to the question sequence following "One Question". Preserved without inventing missing dialogue.

keynoteSlides.title: BUILT WITH INTENTION
keynoteSlides.speaker: CEO
keynoteSlides.script:
Every decision that followed came back to that question.

Every material.

Every interaction.

Every detail.

Guided by one simple belief.

The best technology doesn't compete for your attention.

It quietly earns its place in your life.

keynoteSlides.title: PRODUCT REVEAL
keynoteSlides.speaker: CEO
keynoteSlides.script:
Meet OURO.

Designed Around Life.

Built With Intention.
keynoteSlides.scriptNote: **Transition:** I'd now like to invite our Head of Product to take you behind the thinking, design and engineering of OURO.

keynoteSlides.title: DESIGNED TO DISAPPEAR
keynoteSlides.speaker: Head of Product
keynoteSlides.script:
*On-screen text:* We wanted OURO to disappear into your day...

We wanted OURO to disappear into your day.

Not because it does less...

But because it asks less of you.

Every decision was made to help technology feel natural.

Something that supports your life without demanding your attention.

keynoteSlides.title: CRAFTSMANSHIP
keynoteSlides.speaker: Head of Product
keynoteSlides.script:
Premium products aren't defined by complexity.

They're defined by intention.

Every material...

Every finish...

Every interaction...

Exists because it improves the experience.

keynoteSlides.title: COMPANION APP
keynoteSlides.speaker: Head of Product
keynoteSlides.script:
*Motion/demo opening text:* Great hardware deserves thoughtful software...

Great hardware deserves thoughtful software.

The companion app extends the experience without becoming another distraction.

It gives you effortless control.

Personalization.

Noise control.

Transparency.

Everything is designed to get you back to what matters.

keynoteSlides.title: CLOSING
keynoteSlides.speaker: Head of Product
keynoteSlides.script:
Every product reflects the values of the people who create it.

OURO reflects our belief that technology should quietly earn its place in people's lives.

Thank you.
